note: Quest rewards the FFXIV Online Store (Mog Station) also sells, so they are not exclusive to the quest. Keyed by the store item's Item row id; kind and rewardId name the collectible that item unlocks (the game's Mount/Companion/Emote/Orchestrion/BuddyEquip/Ornament row id, which FFXIV Collect shares), so a reward a quest grants directly (an emote with no item) still matches. DataGen marks every unique_quests.json entry delivered as the item or granting the collectible with otherSources OnlineStore; the plugin shows those as store re-sells. Source: FFXIV Collect entries with a quest source and a Premium: Online Store source (docs/data/verification-report-2.md row 8); name is the collectible's name as FFXIV Collect lists it. Strict JSON; keep sorted by item id; every entry needs name, kind, rewardId, evidence and note.
